hook.say: True or false? Five facts about famous place names, three seconds each. Number five has gone to the dogs!

outro.say: How many did you get? Comment your score!

questions.q: The name of the Pacific Ocean means peaceful.
questions.fact: Magellan named it Mar Pacífico, the peaceful sea, in 1520.
questions.sayAnswer: True! Magellan named it the peaceful sea after finding calm waters.

questions.q: America is named after Christopher Columbus.
questions.fact: It is named after the Italian explorer Amerigo Vespucci.
questions.sayAnswer: False! It is named after the Italian explorer Amerigo Vespucci.

questions.q: Argentina is named after the Latin word for silver.
questions.fact: Argentum is Latin for silver, like the Río de la Plata, the silver river.
questions.sayAnswer: True! Argentum is Latin for silver. Explorers hoped to find plenty of it there.

questions.q: New Zealand is named after a province of the Netherlands.
questions.fact: Dutch mapmakers named it after their coastal province of Zeeland.
questions.sayAnswer: True! Dutch mapmakers named it after their coastal province of Zeeland.

questions.q: The Canary Islands are named after canary birds.
questions.fact: The birds are named after the islands. The name likely comes from dogs.
questions.sayAnswer: False! It is the other way round. The name probably comes from the Latin for dogs.
